packageRules.description: Disable all routine npm version bumps. Dockerfile and tekton updates are unaffected. The next rule re-enables npm updates that fix known vulnerabilities.
Re-enable npm updates only when Renovate marks them as vulnerability alerts (isVulnerabilityAlert), i.e. [SECURITY] PRs from GitHub/OSV.
Disable routine GitHub Actions version bumps. The next rule re-enables Action updates that fix known vulnerabilities.
Re-enable GitHub Actions updates only when Renovate marks them as vulnerability alerts (isVulnerabilityAlert), i.e. [SECURITY] PRs.
Allow Dockerfile base image updates on an immediate schedule so MintMaker can open Konflux image bump PRs regularly.
